correctness.rationale: One-sided absence of label 2 forces the opposite side to be wholly positive and cannot attain a feasible weight below six. At weight six, three label-2 vertices are impossible, leaving one label 2 and one label 1 per side. Matched-partner forcing then gives exactly the two optimizer families, whose converse feasibility is immediate. The included exhaustive checker confirms the theorem through n=7.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete optimizer classification and exact count on a standard dense regular bipartite family. It also identifies a sharp structural effect of deleting a perfect matching from K_n,n: the minimum rises from four to six because unique defenders lose their matched support adjacency.
